_comment: Exact git refs (tag or SHA) of pine-lang and beamlynx-ui bundled into this desktop build. Checked out directly by CI via these refs -- update deliberately as part of a release, per RELEASING.md. pine-lang bumped to master's merge commit for 0.39.0 (pine-lang doesn't tag releases, so this is a SHA, not a tag) -- heuristic-join type casting, join-less table hints, and on-demand schema reindex (used by the new connection refresh icon). beamlynx-ui bumped to its tagged 0.50.0, which bundles canvas mode's keyboard control, the connection refresh/rename features, and the About section's version rows.
